slides.works_in: Any deck with white and black
slides.hook: Three mana, instant speed, exile any nonland permanent. No conditions on what it hits.

reasons.text: Exile, not destroy. Indestructible, regeneration and death triggers all stop mattering.
Instant speed means you hold it for the thing that actually matters.
About as wide as instant-speed removal gets. Commander, planeswalker, enchantment, artifact.

slides.watch_out: Three life every time. In a deck already paying life for lands and tutors, that gets real.

slides.question: Which commander do you always save your removal for?
